thread:
samir: Heads-up: Customer reported a 500 on /v1/chat-completions but they were throttled by a per-route tenant quota. They expected 429.
anya: Oof. Can you paste the response and any headers?
samir: ```http
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
X-Route: chat-shard-11
X-Quota-Check: deferred
X-Trace-Id: trc-11a2

{ "error": "service_unavailable" }
```
drew: This is the late-quota problem again: route-side admission checks can reject after gateway forwarded, so clients see 5xx. Gateway currently only emits 429 when it blocks at ingress.
phil: Contract suggestion: carry a terminal "client_status" annotation back to the gateway (values: quota|infra|unknown). Gateway should canonicalize outward status: client_status=quota -> 429 + headers: `X-Client-Status: quota_exceeded`, `X-Quota-Origin: route|ingress`, `X-Quota-Subcode: tenant_limit`. For infra, keep 5xx but include `X-Client-Status: infra_error`.
anya: Streaming streams caveat: if quota detected mid-stream we can't change HTTP status. Emit a final control chunk like `{"type":"terminal","client_status":"quota_exceeded","code":429}` and close the stream. SDKs must handle that. Add to streaming docs.
drew: Telemetry: add `client_visible_status` metric with labels `client_status`, `quota_origin`, `route`, `subcode`. Dashboards should show fraction of 5xx with client_status=quota so SREs can spot misattributed failures.
samir: Console UX: show a subtle per-route badge when >0.5% of requests map to quota, copy: "Route limited by tenant quota. Visit Quotas to request an increase." Link to per-route quota timeline.
phil: Rollout plan: feature-flag `normalize_error_contract` on gateway and route proxies. Canary 5% for 12h, then 25% for 24h. Monitor: 1) expected rise in 429s, 2) no spike in infra 5xx, 3) stream truncation errors. Pager if stream truncation > 1% of affected traffic.
anya: SDK docs: recommend checking `X-Client-Status` first. Treat quota as client-driven backoff; 429 -> exponential backoff with jitter. 5xx -> retryable but use conservative retry policy. Add sample snippet for stream terminal handling.
drew: Tests: add an integration test that simulates deferred quota and asserts gateway emits 429 + headers, and a streaming test for terminal chunk.
samir: Ownership: @phil will add the annotation and mapping, @drew adds telemetry + tests, @anya updates SDK + streams docs, I'll draft the customer note.
ops-bot: deploy started: feat/normalize_error_contract -> gateway-canary (5%)
samir: I'll monitor logs for `client_status` vs `internal_cause` so we can iterate on header names. Please keep PR comments focused on header naming and dashboard labels.
